member1: Chemical identity determines biological effect: the physiological effect of a food-derived molecule depends on its molecular structure, not whether it came from a ‘natural’ source or was synthesized in a lab. If two preparations deliver the same molecule with the same structure, their direct biochemical effects will be the same regardless of ancestry. This principle clarifies why isolating specific nutrients or phytochemicals can reproduce effects attributed to whole foods when the active molecules are identical.
